results.text: Effect of weight-maintaining ketogenic diet on glycemic control and insulin sensitivity in obese T2D subjects. Low carbohydrate ketogenic diets have received renewed interest for the treatment of obesity and type 2 diabetes. These diets promote weight loss, improve glycemic control, and reduce insulin resistance.
